function.name: apdex_settings_api_ApdexSettingsApi_create_apdex_configuration
function.description: Creates a new Apdex configuration setting that defines the threshold for user satisfaction based on response times. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

threshold.description: The response time in seconds under which a transaction is considered satisfactory. This is a float type value.

name.description: The name of the Apdex configuration setting.

enabled.description: A flag indicating if the Apdex configuration is enabled.

tolerated_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the threshold to determine when a transaction is tolerated. This is a float type value.

frustrated_multiplier.description: Multiplier applied to the threshold to determine when a transaction is considered frustrating. This is a float type value.
